<b>{{PAGENAME}}s</b> are a relatively rare resource that can be obtained through a variety of methods. With the [[Smithing (Tech Tree)#Jeweler|Jeweler]] technology, they can be processed into [[Silver ingot]]s at a [[Furnace II]] or [[Furnace III]], which currently may only be sold to the [[Merchant]] for money. Once a single nugget has been [[Study table|studied]], nuggets can be broken down into a [[Silver powder]] for use in [[alchemy]].

==Sources==
*By [[mining]] and processing [[iron ore]] after opening the [[Building (Tech Tree)#Precious Metals|Precious Metals]] technology:
**mining iron ore blocks from the [[Mining#Iron Deposit|Iron Deposit]], located in the north-west corner of the map, near the [[Quarry]]. Chance is 20% per block with the [[Perks#Miner Perk|Miner perk]] (tested on PC version 1.407).
**processing these blocks into ore at a stone cutter. A 30% chance to get 2 nuggets from each block, the same chance for both [[Stone cutter]] and [[Stone cutter II]] (tested on PC version 1.407).
*While exploring the [[dungeon]], you may come across:
**silver ore veins, requiring a pickaxe to mine, each yielding 8 nuggets, or 9 if the [[Perks#Jeweler Perk|Jeweler perk]] is unlocked.
**[[Monsters#Golems|Silver Golems]] on levels 13 and 14, dropping 2-5 nuggets each.
*By processing the [[silver crucian]] fish at the [[cooking table]], each yielding 1 nugget.
*From the [[Moneylender]] in the [[Refugee camp]] for {{Money|700}} (with the ''[[Game of Crone]]'' DLC).

It is '''not''' possible to find any precious metals in the [[Mining#Bog Ore|bog iron deposits]].
